source: Physical remote-measured full-travel durations (trusted) + tape-measured rail spans and truck bed height (user-provided).

hoist.note: Heights measured floor-to-hook-tip. DOWN (173cm) is above truck_bed_height_cm (138cm) - hook reaches down to top of stacked bales, not the bed surface, consistent with top-2-layers-only scope. Duration assumed same for up and down (symmetric motor).

usage: Convert a relay pulse duration on an axis to real distance via speed_cm_per_s. E.g. a 5s EAST pulse moves the crane about 5 * 9.608 = 48cm East. NOTE: Modbus command latency (see crane_remote.py) can make short pulses (<2-3s) unreliable - these speeds are most accurate for longer, sustained moves.
